column1: # static-intrusive-list-teardown-owners - which static each of the 224 teardowns unlinks (FABLE, 2026-09-17).
# teardown: the 82-byte member. head: the node it unlinks (prev +0, next +8, owner +0x10, name +0x18, flags +0x20; the teardown tests flags bit 0 and frees the name pointer).
# initialiser: the class-registration function whose guarded block (MSVC _Init_thread_header 008092FC / _Init_thread_footer 0080929C) builds the node and registers the teardown with atexit 00808B90.
# kind: name-node = a function-local static built by 00632FB0(node, owner, name, flags) and linked into the owner descriptor's list at +0xA0 (216);
#       global-list-node = a .data node appended inline to a global list referenced only by its own registration function (8; owner column = that list head).
# owner_class: the RTTI class of the vftable installed into the owner static; entry_name: the string passed as the node's name; flags: the constant passed (bit 0 never set).
# Method: capstone over the 51 initialiser bodies and the rip-target census of .text; Tools/work/rtti/vtables.tsv for class names.
